Auralia Steelstrike is the Arathi Quartermaster and the daughter of General Steelstrike. She is described as the backbone of the Arathi Army. Though General Steelstrike leads it, Auralia is the one who ensures it actually runs. She has a gift for organization that is of great necessity to the Arathi.

Augermu is a bronze dragonspawn located at the Horrific Visions Revisited base camp south of the Coreway in Dornogal. He serves as the lead visions researcher, trading Displaced Corrupted Mementos for an Echo of N'zoth to use in the Hourglass of Horrific Visions upgrade tree. After unlocking rune enchants, he also sells replacement corruption effect helm runes.
Attwogaz's Plaque is found next to Attwogaz in the Warrens in the Ringing Deeps.

Augur's Ephemeral Brilliance is the cloak appearance belonging to the Augur's Ephemeral Plumage appearance set. It can only be obtained as an equippable item by converting a Season 3 cloak at the Catalyst in Dornogal, though the appearance can be purchased via Ensemble: Augur's Ephemeral Brilliance.

Aurora Vabsley is a Forsaken located next to a Scenic Getaway Portal at the Gala of Gifts in Durotar during Love is in the Air. She sent her projections to capital cities. Occasionally, she can be seen opening a portal for Gala Attendees. Another projection brings gifts to the Steam Pools visitors. She is friends with Karn Goreshot and wants to gain Laverne Cameron's attention and had the adventurer send her a bouquet. She can be seen outside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris during the Bronze Celebration, along with Gabbo Blinkwink. They are throwing stuff into a portal.
